name: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Ltd
title: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Ltd - 538668 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with no supply-side disclosure; FY26 revenue INR46.2 cr (+15.8%) but PAT fell ~43% and operating cash flow negative, with pipeline claims unquantified by capacity or cost discipline.

triggers.label: Operating cash flow negative despite profits
triggers.quote: Despite profitability, our operating cash flow has been negative.

triggers.label: GDV to double in three years, unquantified
triggers.quote: In the coming three years, and I will not give you a number, but you can expect us doubling the GDV overall.

triggers.label: Andheri pressure from multiple launches
triggers.quote: there has been pressure on the Andheri market because of nultiple launches.

guidance.quote: planning to add three to five new projects annually
an estimated GDV exceeding INR2,100 crores of Mumbai and adjoining markets
the date blocked for the launch is 22nd of June

red_flags.label: PAT down ~43% and EBITDA margin 29% to 22%
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margin has also declined from 29% to 22% in FY26.

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow
red_flags.quote: Despite profitability, our operating cash flow has been negative.

red_flags.label: Vague land and approvals timelines
red_flags.quote: approvals have slowed down over the last three- four months.

evasions.quote: giving you a land holding as an answer for a redevelopment specialist doesn't make sense for us.
honestly I'm not allowed to talk numbers at this stage.
